edges.reason: msg.sender is the token holder whose balance is debited in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender owns the allowance being set in approve.
Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
pause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
unpause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
SlotTicket.mint is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
SlotTicket.destroy is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
The payable fallback is reachable by any external msg.sender.
msg.sender funds the purchase, receives the tickets and is sent the change.
Slot.destroy is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeWallet is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
makeUndestroyable is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
The fallback forwards to buyTicketsFor(msg.sender).
buyTicketsFor registers the purchased tickets via addParticipant.
buyTicketsFor sends leftover ETH to msg.sender after issuing tickets.
buyTicketsFor calls the external token.mint on SlotTicket.
addParticipant calls awardPrizes when the game fills up.
addParticipant calls distributeRemaining after awarding prizes.
addParticipant concludes the game via increaseGame.
awardPrizes derives the winner index from rand.
awardPrizes calls distributeJackpot when the jackpot condition holds.
awardPrizes transfers prize ETH to winners inside a loop before the loop state advances.
distributeJackpot transfers the whole jackpot to the selected winner.
distributeRemaining transfers ETH to the wallet and to msg.sender.
refundGameAfterLongInactivity opens a new game via increaseGame.
refundGameAfterLongInactivity transfers PRICE to each participant in a loop.
counter -= counter%SIZE uses unchecked raw uint256 arithmetic.
SlotTicket.destroy calls selfdestruct(owner).
Slot.destroy calls selfdestruct(owner).
Slot.destroy calls the external token.destroy.
BasicToken.transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit msg.sender.
BasicToken.transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit _to.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balances[_from] and the allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for balances[_to].
mint uses SafeMath.add for totalSupply and balances.
distributeRemaining uses SafeMath.add on jackpotAmount.
refundGameAfterLongInactivity uses SafeMath.sub to measure block inactivity.
